# Publication information
## Michelle C. Agne, Robert A. Slesak, Constance A. Harrington, Beth A. Roskilly, Kristen L. Chadwick, Melissa Fischer
## Assisted population migration of Douglas-fir using operational transfer guidelines has limited risk to tree health
## Ecological Applications
### In review/revision

# Purpose
Wrangle tree health indicator data by site and regional provenance to present proportion of trees in each site x provenance combination with each severity level of the eight indicators (Appendix Figures S1-S8)

Table 2: Calculate the proportion of trees with each indicator by site, then by regional provenance
Table 3: Calculate the proportion of trees with each indicator by site and regional provenance combination 
  -proportion of trees from the local source with each indicator shown by site with range by provenance (min and max) shown by site and indicator
  -List of sites followed by their local provenance:
    - Floras - ORCSTS
    - Stone Nursery - ORSISL
    - Evans Creek - ORSISH
    - Nortons - ORCSTN
    - Slice Butte - ORCASL
    - Soda320 - ORCASH
    - Jammer3 - WACST
    - Buckhorn2 - WACASL
    - Doorstop - WACASH
    Note that sources CACST, CAKLA, CASIERRA do not have a local site in the experiment


```{r, include=FALSE}
#load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(patchwork)
```


```{r, include=FALSE}
# Read in data
data <- read.csv("field_climate_08_23_w18_21_growth_NSavgs.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE, na.strings="NA") 
```

# Table 2
## By site
### Chlorosis
```{r, echo=FALSE}
CC_site<-data %>% filter(!is.na(CC)) %>%group_by(SITE_NAME, CC) %>% summarize(total = sum(count)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = CC, names_prefix = "CC_", values_from = total, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(CCTrees = CC_1 + CC_2 + CC_3) %>%
  mutate(Prop_CC1 = round(CC_1/CCTrees, digits=3),
         Prop_CC2 = round(CC_2/CCTrees, digits=3),
         Prop_CC3 = round(CC_3/CCTrees, digits=3))%>%
  mutate(Prop_CC23 = Prop_CC2 + Prop_CC3) # this column contains the values for the Chlorosis column
```

### Crown sparseness
```{r, echo=FALSE}
CT_site <- data %>% filter(!is.na(CT)) %>%group_by(SITE_NAME, CT) %>% summarize(total = sum(count)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = CT, names_prefix = "CT_", values_from = total, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(CTTrees = CT_1 + CT_2 + CT_3 + CT_4) %>%
  mutate(Prop_CT1 = round(CT_1/CTTrees, digits=3),
         Prop_CT2 = round(CT_2/CTTrees, digits=3),
         Prop_CT3 = round(CT_3/CTTrees, digits=3),
         Prop_CT4 = round(CT_4/CTTrees, digits=3))%>%
  mutate(Prop_CT234 = Prop_CT2 + Prop_CT3+Prop_CT4) # this column contains the values for the Sparse crown column
```

### Branch dieback
```{r, echo=FALSE}
BrDB_site <- data %>% filter(!is.na(BrDB)) %>%group_by(SITE_NAME, BrDB) %>% summarize(total = sum(count))%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = BrDB, names_prefix = "BrDB_", values_from = total, values_fill = 0)%>%
  mutate(BrDBtrees = BrDB_0 + BrDB_1 + BrDB_2)%>%
  mutate(Prop_BrDB0 = round(BrDB_0/BrDBtrees, digits=3),
         Prop_BrDB1 = round(BrDB_1/BrDBtrees, digits=3),
         Prop_BrDB2 = round(BrDB_2/BrDBtrees, digits=3))%>%
  mutate(Prop_BrDB12 = Prop_BrDB1 + Prop_BrDB2)# this column contains the values for the Branch dieback column
```

### Top dieback
```{r, echo=FALSE}
TopDB_site <- data %>% filter(!is.na(TopDB))%>% group_by(SITE_NAME, TopDB) %>% summarize(total = sum(count))%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = TopDB, names_prefix = "TopDB_", values_from = total, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(TopDBtrees = TopDB_0 + TopDB_1 + TopDB_2 + TopDB_3) %>%
  mutate(Prop_TopDB0 = round(TopDB_0/TopDBtrees, digits=3),
        Prop_TopDB1 = round(TopDB_1/TopDBtrees, digits=3),
         Prop_TopDB2 = round(TopDB_2/TopDBtrees, digits=3),
         Prop_TopDB3 = round(TopDB_3/TopDBtrees, digits=3)) %>%
  mutate(Prop_TopDB123 = Prop_TopDB1 + Prop_TopDB2 + Prop_TopDB3) # this column contains the values for the top dieback column
```

# Appendix figures
## Proportion by chlorosis class by site and regional provenance
Figure S1
```{r, echo=FALSE}
CC_sumlong<-data %>% filter(!is.na(CC)) %>%group_by(SITE_NAME, REGION, CC) %>% summarize(total = sum(count)) %>%
  mutate(CC = as.factor(CC))%>%
  mutate(SITE_NAME = as.factor(SITE_NAME))%>%
      mutate(SITE_NAME = fct_relevel(SITE_NAME, "Floras", "StoneNursery", "EvansCreek", "Nortons", "SliceButte", "Soda320",
                                "Jammer3", "Buckhorn2", "Doorstop")) %>%
  mutate(REGION = as.factor(REGION))%>%
   mutate(REGION = fct_relevel(REGION, "CACST", "CAKLA", "CASIERRA", "ORCSTS", "ORSISL", "ORSISH", "ORCSTN", "ORCASL", "ORCASH",
                              "WACST", "WACASL", "WACASH"))


palCC<-hcl.colors(10, palette="ag_GrnYl")
palCC_man <- c("#3C5941","#8ECF69","#EDEF5C")

(p2<-ggplot(CC_sumlong, aes(x = REGION, y = total, fill = CC)) +
    facet_wrap(~SITE_NAME, scales='free')+
  geom_col(position = "fill")+
  labs(x = "Regional provenance", y="Proportion measured trees")+
      theme_classic()+
     theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 55, vjust = 0.95, hjust = 0.95),
            legend.position="top")+
   scale_fill_manual(values=palCC_man, name="Chlorosis"))

ann_text<-data.frame(REGION=c(4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12),
                     SITE_NAME=factor(c("Floras", "StoneNursery", "EvansCreek", "Nortons", "SliceButte", "Soda320",
                                "Jammer3", "Buckhorn2", "Doorstop")),
                     total=c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5),
                     CC=c('1','1','1','1','1','1','1','1','1'),
                     label=c("*","*","*","*","*","*","*","*","*"))

(p2new<-p2 + geom_text(
  data    = ann_text, label = ann_text$label, color="white"))

#ggsave(p2new, file="SIFigCrownColor_SiteRegion_20251030.png", dpi=300, height=7.5, width=7)
```


## Proportion by crown sparseness class by site and regional provenance
Figure S2
```{r, echo=FALSE}
CT_sumlong<-data %>% filter(!is.na(CT)) %>%group_by(SITE_NAME,REGION, CT) %>% summarize(total = sum(count)) %>%
  mutate(CT = as.factor(CT))%>%
  mutate(SITE_NAME = as.factor(SITE_NAME))%>%
  mutate(SITE_NAME = fct_relevel(SITE_NAME, "Floras", "StoneNursery", "EvansCreek", "Nortons", "SliceButte", "Soda320",
                                "Jammer3", "Buckhorn2", "Doorstop"))%>%
  mutate(REGION = as.factor(REGION))%>%
   mutate(REGION = fct_relevel(REGION, "CACST", "CAKLA", "CASIERRA", "ORCSTS", "ORSISL", "ORSISH", "ORCSTN", "ORCASL", "ORCASH",
                              "WACST", "WACASL", "WACASH"))

palCT<-hcl.colors(10, palette="Greens")
palCT_man <- c("#004616","#2B8238","#93CA8B","#D0EBC8")

(p3<-ggplot(CT_sumlong, aes(x = REGION, y = total, fill = CT)) +
    facet_wrap(~SITE_NAME, scales='free')+
  geom_col(position = "fill")+
  labs(x = "Regional provenance", y="Proportion measured trees")+
      theme_classic()+
      theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 55, vjust = 0.95, hjust = 0.95),
            legend.position="top")+
   scale_fill_manual(values=palCT_man, name="Crown sparseness"))

ann_text<-data.frame(REGION=c(4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12),
                     SITE_NAME=factor(c("Floras", "StoneNursery", "EvansCreek", "Nortons", "SliceButte", "Soda320",
                                "Jammer3", "Buckhorn2", "Doorstop")),
                     total=c(0.7,0.7,0.7,0.7,0.7,0.7,0.7,0.7,0.7),
                     CT=c('1','1','1','1','1','1','1','1','1'),
                     label=c("*","*","*","*","*","*","*","*","*"))

(p3new<-p3 + geom_text(
  data    = ann_text, label = ann_text$label, color="white"))
#ggsave(p3new, file="SIFigCrownSparseness_SiteRegion_20251030.png", dpi=300, height=7.5, width=7)
```


## Proportion by top dieback class by site and regional provenance
Figure S5
```{r, echo=FALSE}
TopDB_sumlong<-data %>% filter(!is.na(TopDB)) %>%group_by(SITE_NAME, REGION,TopDB) %>% summarize(total = sum(count)) %>%
  mutate(TopDB = as.factor(TopDB))%>%
  mutate(TopDB = fct_relevel(TopDB, "0","1","2","3")) %>%
  mutate(SITE_NAME = as.factor(SITE_NAME))%>%
  mutate(SITE_NAME = fct_relevel(SITE_NAME, "Floras", "StoneNursery", "EvansCreek", "Nortons", "SliceButte", "Soda320",
                                "Jammer3", "Buckhorn2", "Doorstop"))%>%
  mutate(REGION = as.factor(REGION))%>%
```
